## Person Operations

Bed

[![Bed](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/3/30/Bed.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/100?cb=20190317010734)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/3/30/Bed.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317010734)

A place to sleep.

Medical Bed

[![Medical Bed](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/2/27/Medical_Bed.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/100?cb=20190317010753)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/2/27/Medical_Bed.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317010753)

A place for injured persons.

Passenger Seat

[![Passenger Seat](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/5/59/Passenger_Seat.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20200130200047)

Padded Seat

[![Padded Seat](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/1/12/Padded_Seat.png/revision/latest?cb=20200130195905)

Stretcher

[![Stretcher](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/0/07/Stretcher.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317010844)

a floating bed to rescue persons, with handles. Can be attached to a winch.

Harness

[![Harness](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/8/80/Harness.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317010742)

Can hold a person. Can be attached to a winch.

Heater

[![Heater](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/5/55/Heater.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317010747)

Makes warm. Helps you survive the arctic.
